text:
maya: Quick cross-team check — launching the new open-model entry today. Short checklist: licensing signoff, perf profiles, final PR merges, console metadata/assets, and canary infra. Who is owning which gate?

jamal: I can take PR merges and the final manifest. will hold until legal signoff and CI green.

olivia: Docs/console metadata here — I have the PRs but need model-card images from research. pinged @maya for assets.

dinesh: Perf status: most workloads pass. seeing a regression on long-context (4k) for mosaic7b-quant. running a targeted eval now (ETA ~4h). command I'm running: ```make perf-report MODEL=mosaic7b-quant TARGET=context=4096```

rachel: Legal: CC-BY-SA and most permissive OSS are ok if attribution + weight-source noted. orchid7b (third-party weights) needs explicit attribution text; I'll post the exact language in a minute.

legal-bot: Automated license scan: flagged MODEL-ORCHID7B weights (third-party) — ticket infra#3241 created for traceability.

maya: Thanks. For rollout policy I propose: canary 5% (24h monitor) -> 20% (24h) -> full. Also need someone to merge the final model-manifest PR (#4682).

jamal: I'll merge once legal signs off and CI passes. @infra-bot can you confirm canary infra capacity?

infra-bot: Canary capacity check: clusters available 3/3, autoscale policy within thresholds, no GPU shortages reported. Ready for 5% canary.

olivia: Note: console schema change in the metadata endpoint may require a lightweight migration for older model-cards — leaving a note on the PR.

dinesh: Update on perf: fixed regression with a small kernel tweak to KV cache codepath. Re-ran 4k evals, all green. I'll upload the new perf profile as `profiles/mosaic7b-4k.json`.

maya: Awesome. Final owner map for clarity: licensing -> rachel, merge -> jamal, perf profile -> dinesh, assets -> olivia, infra -> infra-bot. If all green by EOD I'll run: ```scripts/launch_model.sh --model=orchid7b --version=1.0.0 --canary=5%```

rachel: Legal sign-off posted. Required model-card text: "weights: third-party; attribution required (see LICENSE_NOTICE)." Please include that verbatim.

jamal: :thumbsup: merging #4682 now. will wait for CI then kick the canary.

maya: Merged and canary started at 17:03 UTC. Monitoring dashboards up (console: /models/orchid7b/monitor). Will post updates if anything flaps. Great work everyone :tada:
